thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Rating Update from a Top Analyst

author: Catie Powers
title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Rating Update from a Top Analyst
text:
Catie Powers - January 30, 2019, 7:50 AM EDT SHARE ON:
Monness analyst Brian White maintained a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL ) today and set a price target of $220 . yesterday at $154.68, close to its 52-week low of $142.
 White is a top 100 analyst with an average return of 19.1% and a 66.0% success rate. White covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as Spotify Technology SA, Salesforce.com, and Alphabet Inc.
Currently, the analyst consensus on Apple is a Moderate Buy with an average price target of $183.98, implying a 18.9% upside from current levels. In a report issued on January 18, RBC Capital also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $185 price target.
See today’s analyst top recommended stocks >>
Apple’s market cap is currently $735.5B and has a P/E ratio of 13.03. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 6.86.
Based on the recent corporate insider activity of 58 insiders, corporate insider sentiment is positive on the stock. This means that over the past quarter there has been an increase of insiders buying their shares of AAPL in relation to earlier this year. Earlier this month, Albert Gore, a Director at AAPL bought 35,000 shares for a total of $507,850.
